title: Stocks to watch: Reliance Industries, Tata Motors, Bharat Electronics, Cipla, Titan Company
text: Here are the stocks to watch in trade today. Bharat Electronics said it has won an order worth Rs 2,100 crore from the Ministry of Defence for the supply of radar systems. Reliance Industries will hold its annual general meeting later this month, where the company is expected to update shareholders on its retail business. Tata Motors reported monthly sales volumes broadly in line with expectations. Cipla said its board will meet on Friday. Titan Company opened four new stores during the quarter. Nifty and Sensex ended the previous session marginally lower, while Bank Nifty outperformed.
